In the world's great arboreta, volunteers are the **heart of the project**: they
guide visits, care for the collections, record data, propagate species in the nursery
and bring events to life. At the Arboretum of Estancia La Constancia we are **building
our volunteer program**, and we invite you to be part of it from the start.

::: {.callout-tip}
**The program is taking its first steps.** If you're interested, leave us your details
and we'll get in touch to get to know you, tell you about the available tasks and find
the best way for you to contribute together.
:::

<div style="text-align:center; margin:1.5rem 0 2rem;">
[<i class="bi bi-hand-thumbs-up"></i> I want to volunteer](contact.html){.btn .btn-success .btn-lg role="button"}
</div>

## How you can help

Inspired by the volunteer programs of leading arboreta, these are the areas we are
opening. For most, no prior experience is needed: we support and train you.

::: grid

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### <i class="bi bi-flower2"></i> Guides and hosts
Welcome groups, accompany tours and share the story of the arboretum.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### 📋 Survey and data
Map specimens, fill in profiles, measure trees and record phenology (flowering,
fruiting).
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### <i class="bi bi-binoculars"></i> Birdwatching
Monitoring resident and migratory birds, and logging observations on citizen-science
platforms.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### 🌱 Nursery and planting
Propagating species, sowing, planting and caring for the new collections.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### <i class="bi bi-mortarboard"></i> Educational support
Assisting with school visits, workshops and activities for all ages.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .card .p-4 .shadow-sm}
### 📣 Events and outreach
Helping with events, social media, photography and communication of the project.
:::

:::

## Who can join?

Volunteering is **open to all ages and backgrounds**: students looking for field
experience, retirees with time and enthusiasm, nature lovers, teachers, photographers,
bird enthusiasts… For many tasks **no prior knowledge is required**; what matters is
commitment and a willingness to learn.

## What you'll take away

- <i class="bi bi-tree"></i> **Real learning** in botany, ecology, birds and conservation, alongside professionals.
- <i class="bi bi-people"></i> **Community**: being part of a team with purpose.
- <i class="bi bi-sun"></i> **Nature and wellbeing**: quality time outdoors.
- 📜 **Certificate of participation** recognizing your contribution.
- 💚 **Concrete impact**: your work helps conserve and share the natural heritage.

## Frequently asked questions

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Do I need prior experience or training?"}
For most tasks, no. We support and train you according to the area you choose. If you
already have experience (in botany, birds, education, communication), even better!
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="How much time do I need to give?"}
We arrange it around your availability. It can be a one-off day, help at an event, or a
more regular involvement. We talk and find the format that suits you.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Is there a minimum age?"}
Volunteering is open to different ages. If you are a minor or would like to bring a
group of young people, write to us and we'll arrange the conditions for taking part.
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Is there any cost?"}
No. Volunteering is a **collaboration**: you give your time and we welcome, train and
support you.
:::

## Join in

Tell us who you are, what you'd like to do and your availability. We'll reply shortly
to take the first step together.
